about.subtitle.en-US: A home cleaning technology company built around the motor.
about.subtitle.zh-CN: 围绕电机打造的家清科技公司。

about.body.en-US:
LYHOTEC is a home cleaning technology company. We design and manufacture vacuum cleaners, fabric cleaning machines and leaf blowers around a single high-speed digital motor platform — engineered, tooled and assembled in our own factory.

Everything that matters is built in-house: the motor, the battery cell pack, the firmware and the control electronics. Owning the core lets us hold every product to one engineering standard, and iterate it as fast as the motor itself improves.

We do not chase surface styling. The work is in efficiency, runtime, noise and weight — the numbers a user actually feels. The result is a product line that looks quiet because it is quiet.
about.body.zh-CN:
LYHOTEC 是一家家清科技公司。我们围绕自研的高速数码电机平台,设计并制造吸尘器、布艺清洗机与吹叶机,在自己的工厂内完成研发、开模与总装。

所有关键核心均自研自造:电机、电池封装、固件与控制电路。掌握核心,让我们能够以同一工程标准要求每一台产品,并随电机本身的进步快速迭代。

我们不追求表面造型,而是把功夫放在效率、续航、噪音与重量——用户真正感知到的数字。由此造就的产品线,看起来安静,是因为它确实安静。
